label: Every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link
paraphrase: OPEN analyst sense bridge, attribution deferred: whenever here and now c efficiently causes the being of x per se, as caused (SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4, definition 57348ddc), c causes x as a caused cause (CausesAsCaused, SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3, DEF 4a101a4c): a per se cause of being is a middle cause of a per se series of efficient causes. Positive warrant: SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 is the secunda via's respect-free per se link, and a present per se cause of being is a per se efficient cause in the respect of being. Support option: it follows from the secunda via's per se ordering premise 8a22ae75 (strong reading A), no self-causation 8b2561cd and the premise that an existential link's cause is itself efficiently caused here and now in some respect (this batch). Kept mode gap: AsCaused says only that c's esse is caused, in a mode it leaves unspecified, while DEF 4a101a4c requires a middle cause to be efficiently caused here and now; a cause of being whose own being is caused non-efficiently, or not now, would be a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link and no SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link. No case of that kind is on file. It is not definitional (CausesAsCaused is a primitive). The converse is not asserted and fails on the hand-and-stick case (a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link through c2880fe0 that causes no being).
